text: Upon identifying the customer as a foreign politically exposed person, senior management approval was obtained before the account was opened, and enhanced ongoing monitoring was implemented.
label: Compliant

text: PEP screening was not conducted on the family members of the identified politically exposed customer, despite this being flagged as a requirement in the internal policy.
label: Non-Compliant

text: An acknowledgment of KYC updation was issued to the customer, though the underlying documents supporting the update are not attached to the file.
label: Ambiguous

text: The customer's KYC information has not been updated in over nine years, despite the account being classified as high risk.
label: Non-Compliant

text: The intermediary bank failed to retain originator information when forwarding a chain of wire transfers, contrary to the applicable retention requirement.
label: Non-Compliant

text: An internal alert was generated for the account, but the file does not indicate whether the alert was reviewed or dismissed by the compliance team.
label: Ambiguous

text: The customer was categorised as high-risk based on documented parameters including business activity, geography, and transaction profile, with the categorisation reviewed every six months as required.
label: Compliant

text: The risk score changed in the system but no explanation or supporting rationale was documented for the change.
label: Ambiguous

text: Several wire transfers just under the reporting threshold were processed for the same beneficiary in a short window without any review for possible structuring.
label: Non-Compliant

text: The account showed a sharp increase in turnover inconsistent with its historical balance, and while a note was made, no formal investigation appears in the record.
label: Ambiguous

text: The compliance officer confidentially filed an STR without informing the customer or account-facing staff, in accordance with the tipping-off prohibition.
label: Compliant

text: A large cash deposit inconsistent with the customer's declared salary was investigated, found to have a legitimate documented source, and appropriately closed without escalation.
label: Compliant
